ck_albums_dates.name: ck_albums_dates
ck_albums_dates.value: "albums"."start_date" IS NULL OR "albums"."end_date" IS NULL OR "albums"."start_date" <= "albums"."end_date"

ck_recipient_contactable.name: ck_recipient_contactable
ck_recipient_contactable.value: "capsule_recipients"."email" IS NOT NULL OR "capsule_recipients"."phone" IS NOT NULL OR "capsule_recipients"."member_id" IS NOT NULL

ck_replies_not_empty.name: ck_replies_not_empty
ck_replies_not_empty.value: "capsule_replies"."body" IS NOT NULL OR "capsule_replies"."media_asset_id" IS NOT NULL

ck_subs_entitlements_sane.name: ck_subs_entitlements_sane
ck_subs_entitlements_sane.value:
"subscriptions"."storage_quota_bytes" >= 0
          AND "subscriptions"."max_video_seconds" > 0
          AND "subscriptions"."seats" >= 1
          AND "subscriptions"."broadcast_recipients_per_month" >= 0
          AND ("subscriptions"."max_pending_capsules" IS NULL OR "subscriptions"."max_pending_capsules" >= 0)
          AND ("subscriptions"."max_capsule_horizon_days" IS NULL OR "subscriptions"."max_capsule_horizon_days" > 0)
